increasing acceleration and then moving at terminal velocity

starts to rotate in a clockwise direction.

metre rule
pivot

Which statement gives a complete description of any object that is in equilibrium?

options.text: There is no resultant force and no resultant turning effect.

Object X has a velocity of 5.0m/s to the right. Object Y has a velocity of 3.0m/s to the left.
5.0 m / s 3.0 m / s
X Y
Object X and object Y collide and stick together.
What is their velocity after colliding?

Brakes are used to slow down a moving car.
Into which form of energy is most of the kinetic energy converted as the car slows down?

A drawing pin (thumb tack) has a sharp point at one end and a flat surface at the other end.
sharp point flat surface
The pin is pushed into a wooden board.
How do the pressure and the force at the sharp point compare with the pressure and the force on
the flat surface?
force at the sharp point pressure at the sharp point

questions.questionText: Which statement about the evaporation of a liquid is correct?

options.text: The least energetic molecules escape from the surface and the temperature of the liquid decreases.
The least energetic molecules escape from the surface and the temperature of the liquid increases.
The most energetic molecules escape from the surface and the temperature of the liquid decreases.
The most energetic molecules escape from the surface and the temperature of the liquid increases.

questions.questionText: Which change in the design of a liquid-in-glass thermometer makes it more sensitive?

A liquid turns into a gas. This occurs only at one particular temperature, and the change happens
throughout the liquid.
What is this process called?

One end of a rod of copper is placed in hot water. Thermal energy travels along the rod to make
the other end warmer.
What is the behaviour of the copper at an atomic level that accounts for most of the transfer of
thermal energy from one end to the other?

options.text: Atoms at the hot end gain kinetic energy and move towards the other end.
Atoms at the hot end expand, colliding with other atoms and transferring energy.
Free electrons at the hot end gain energy and move towards the other end, colliding with atoms along the rod.
Free electrons at the hot end gain energy from the hot water and move directly to the other end.

questions.questionText:
A surface is made so that it is a good source of infrared radiation.
Which surface is not suitable?

options.text: a surface that is painted matt black
a surface that is painted white
a surface that is heated to a high temperature
a surface that has a large surface area

transmitter
hill receiver

through the hill.

options.text: diffraction round the hill. longer wavelengths.
diffraction round the hill. shorter wavelengths.

refraction round the hill. shorter wavelengths.

A steel bar is placed in an East-West direction for it to be demagnetised. No other magnet is
nearby.

options.text: Heating the bar to a very high temperature.
Slowly taking the bar out of a coil that carries an alternating current.

questions.questionText:
A student investigates the output voltage induced across a coil of wire by a bar magnet.
When will the induced voltage have the greatest value?

options.text: The student slowly moves the bar magnet into the coil of wire.
The student leaves the bar magnet stationary in the coil of wire.
The student quickly removes the bar magnet from the coil of wire.

questions.questionText: Why are some radioactive sources stored in boxes made from lead?

options.text: Lead absorbs emissions from the radioactive sources.
Lead decreases the half-life of radioactive sources.
Lead increases the half-life of radioactive sources.
